subject: Launch likelihood & risk compact — QBR prep
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Launch likelihood & risk compact — QBR prep

Team,

I put together a tight snapshot for the QBR packet focused on product + eng launch likelihoods and the biggest delivery risks. Attached: QBR_launch_readiness_v3.pdf and launch_timeline_v2.xlsx (sheet with per-team milestones). High level:

- Launch window target: week of 2027-01-18 (internal gating: infra cert on 2026-12-20; security sign-off 2026-12-22).
- Likelihood today: 60% green for core paths, 40% risk for edge integration flows.
- Top delivery risks: infra perf on long tails, KV cache regressions with quantized checkpoints, and delayed partner contract for SSO.

Asks: please read pages 2–4 in the attached PDF, and reply with a single line each: (1) current launch likelihood (High/Medium/Low), (2) top mitigation you recommend, (3) any blocker that must be escalated this week.

I’ll consolidate replies and present a 1-slide likelihood table in the QBR deck.

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch likelihood & risk compact — QBR prep

Aditya —

Thanks for the summary. My read: Medium likelihood (we're leaning towards green if infra can validate the long-tail perf improvements). Mitigation: schedule an early perf smoke with a 95th/99th token latency profile next week (Nov 9–12) and reserve one dedicated burst node pre-holiday to run worst-case loads. Blockers: none that need exec escalation today but we should watch the partner SSO contract (timeline unknown).

I can own the perf smoke — will coordinate with infra and runtime.

Vivek
VP, Engineering
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch likelihood & risk compact — QBR prep

Quick answers per ask:

1) Launch likelihood: Medium-High for core feature set, Low for partner SSO and marketplace billing flows.
2) Top mitigation: split rollout — GA core features first, soft-launch partner integrations as Beta with feature flags.
3) Blocker: we need legal to confirm a reversible data retention clause for the marketplace pilot; I’ve flagged this with Legal (ticket HB-41234).

I suggest the QBR slide frame show two likelihood columns: core vs integrations, with color-coded mitigations and owners. I can take the integration rollout plan draft.

—Laura
Head of Product
From: Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@acme.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Joe Marquez <joe@cloudops.io>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch likelihood & risk compact — QBR prep

Aditya/Laura —

Appreciate the heads-up. From Acme: we remain committed to the Jan window but need SSO to be in place for our compliance team before full rollout. If it helps, our legal has a standard addendum that can speed the retention language — copied here.

We ran a quick end-to-end test with the staging SSO and saw a non-deterministic redirect in ~1:200 auth flows. We can share logs if the infra team wants them — ping Joe to coordinate.

Sarah
Director, Platform Engineering — Acme Corp
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@acme.com>
Cc: Joe Marquez <joe@cloudops.io>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch likelihood & risk compact — QBR prep

Thanks all — consolidating notes for the QBR slide. Summary for the deck:

- Core feature launch: Target Jan 18, likelihood Medium-High (owners: Product + Eng).
- Integration/SSO: Target Beta alongside GA; full integration depends on partner contract and SSO stability — likelihood Low unless we close addendum and resolve redirect in staging.
- Immediate asks (this week): Vivek to run perf smoke (Nov 9–12); Karthik to confirm infra burst node capacity and cost impact; Laura to lead integration rollout plan and coordinate legal (HB-41234).
- External follow-up: Acme to share staging logs with Joe for infra triage.

I’ll drop the one-slide likelihood table into the QBR deck by Wed EOD and include a short risk lattice with owners. If anyone changes their one-line answers, please update in thread.

Attachments: updated PDF + timeline sheet. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1QBRLaunchReadiness_v3

Aditya
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
